scope: Six previously viewed synthetic development records; non-independent AI-assisted reference. Fresh paired inference with two repetitions; no holdout conclusions.
stage_policy: Same frozen XGBoost stage head and feature support for all visual activity configurations; numeric native baselines retained separately.
selection: Pre-rank all label-free raw motion conflicts; choose at most two disjoint targets, with at least 14 conflicting days; do not reselect after feedback.
fixed_control: At most two 180-day windows nearest equally spaced interior record centers; independent of observations and predictions. Same pure-image outputs shared wherever targets match.
feedback_ablation: Same initial prediction, same adaptive targets, same images, same output contract; add only structured raw short/long persistence summary. Alternate order before every pair.
unknowns: Strict majority of review views covering a day; unknown/failure remains in denominator, reviewed unknown replaces the initial decision. Missing observations remain unknown.
primary: Activity daily P/R/F1 with FP/FN, weak-motion recall, coverage and failures; report each repetition, do not select the best.
secondary: Event IoU0.3 and IoU0.5, boundary errors, end-to-end A/S/D, false acceleration, call/token/service cost.
pilot_continuation: Proceed to new-seed mechanism recovery if numeric feedback reduces FP versus same-target image-only in both repetitions without a recall reduction greater than 0.05 in either. Otherwise diagnose and discard unsupported numeric-feedback claims.
freeze: Save protocol, image/input/source hashes before first request. Save selection before local request. Score only after every prediction has been frozen. Existing sealed test remains isolated.
